name: Cortello's Riddle
summary: Following the trail begun with a waterlogged parchment found in the Swamp of Sorrows, a second cryptic verse urges travelers to a far-off land in Kalimdor. Deciphering the lines points treasure hunters toward a cave in the southwest of Dustwallow Marsh.

sections.title: A Verse Pointing Across the Sea
sections.body: The second verse left by Cortello directs searchers toward the far-off land of Kalimdor. The rhyme describes a perilous and gloomy territory situated east of the Barrens: the sodden, treacherous wetlands of Dustwallow Marsh.

sections.title: The Southwest Cavern
sections.body: According to the riddle, a clue waits to be found in a cave in the southwest of the marsh.

sections.title: Where the Verse Leads
sections.body: The cave in the southwest of the marsh is Bloodfen Burrow, where a musty scroll waits to be found.

faq.q: Where does this riddle send travelers?
aliases: where is the second riddle clue
faq.answer: The verse sends searchers to Kalimdor, specifically to Dustwallow Marsh, which lies east of the Barrens.

faq.q: Where in Dustwallow Marsh is the clue hidden?
aliases: where is the cave in dustwallow
faq.answer: The verse places the clue in a cave in the southwest of the marsh.

faq.q: What item initiates this step of the trail?
faq.answer: This step begins with a soggy scroll found at the end of the first riddle's trail, in the Swamp of Sorrows.
